title: Wyndham Nashville - 1 Bedroom Suite
description:
Music City Vibes | Pool + BBQ Area | Nashville

Experience the best of Nashville from this stylish resort just minutes from downtown’s famous honky-tonks, museums, and live music venues. After a day exploring, relax by the pool, enjoy a workout in the fitness center, or unwind in your suite.

The space
Approximately 504 square feet, this One- Bedroom Suite features 1 King Bed in the master bedroom, 1 Queen Sleeper Sofa in the living room including a kitchenette, and a bathroom. Maximum of 4 occupants.

Other things to note
Please bring a valid Picture ID. If the name of the person checking in is changed after this information is provided, there will be a $99.00 name change fee and $129 on the day of check in. A $250 Pre-Authorization from any major credit card upon checking in is required. Cash is not accepted.
